_comment: Friendly names for the numeric ids EA SPORTS WRC sends.
The ids are not published, so this file starts empty: the tournament shows
'Route 12345' and 'Car 103' until you fill them in.
Run wrc-capture.bat on a stage to see the route_id, location_id and vehicle_id
for the track and car you are using, then add them below. Only the ones you
actually use in the tournament are worth adding.
You can also rename the track and car afterwards in the admin portal.
